_schema.description: Typed lesson metadata sidecar. Keyed by lesson slug (id).

fields.scope: which repo/surface this lesson applies to
fields.applies_to: array of file paths the bug pattern lives in
fields.detector: shell command — exits 0 when the lesson is resolved (bug pattern gone), non-zero when still present
fields.status: one of: observed | open | attempted | resolved
fields.mechanism: file/test pointer for resolved deterministic mechanisms

_schema.note: If a lesson has no detector, self-heal falls back to keyword grep and never auto-promotes status. Observation-only lessons (process rules, not fixable bugs) should carry status:observed and no detector.

inbox-parser-hr-guard.detector: grep -q "startsWith('- ') && t.length > 2" commands/run.js && grep -q "startsWith('- ') && t.length > 2" commands/autopilot.js && grep -q "startsWith('- ') && t.length > 2" commands/workflow.js

error-grind-guards-compose.detector: grep -q "pauseReason = 'model-unavailable'" commands/mission.js && grep -q 'consecutiveSameReasonErrors(ticks)' commands/mission.js && grep -q 'max-ticks-reached' commands/mission.js && grep -q 'missionSelectableForLoop' commands/mission.js

escape-regexp-single-home.detector: ! grep -R -F 'replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g' commands lib --include='*.js' | grep -v 'lib/escape-regexp.js' && grep -q 'function escapeRegExp' lib/escape-regexp.js

outbound-artifacts-must-render-before-se.mechanism: scripts/outbound-artifact-gate.js blocks raw HTML plain sends and missing HTML render proof; test/outbound-artifact-gate.test.js pins bad and good sends.

verify-not-runnable.mechanism: commands/autopilot.js validateVerifyCommandShape rejects markdown backticks and prose expectations before a tick runs; test/autopilot-plan-review.test.js and test/autopilot-verify-vocabulary.test.js pin it.

verify-not-falsifiable.mechanism: commands/autopilot.js pre-runs Verify and records verify-not-falsifiable when it passes before work; test/autopilot-verify-falsifiability.test.js pins trivial, pre-passing, and valid missing-file cases.

play-test-env-leak.mechanism: test/helpers/agent-env.js scrubAgentEnv removes ATRIS_PROFILE, ATRIS_PLAYER, and ATRIS_USERNAME from spawned CLI tests; test/commands.test.js play-mode coverage uses it.

features-gitignored-by-default.mechanism: test/lessons-burndown.test.js checks every public atris/features package entry has matching .gitignore allowlist lines.
features-gitignored-by-default.detector: node --test test/lessons-burndown.test.js --test-name-pattern "current public feature package entries are gitignore-allowlisted"

judge-never-patches.mechanism: lib/task-db.js rejects positive pre-acceptance review when judge equals worker; lib/auto-accept-certified.js requires independent review before autoland.

work-must-land-or-it-never-happened.mechanism: commands/land.js landSummary feeds the boot banner in bin/atris.js and test/land.test.js pins the land board plus reap flow.

private-data-follows-the-files-array.mechanism: test/lessons-burndown.test.js blocks private package roots and requires private/ plus decks/private/ in both gitignore and npmignore.
private-data-follows-the-files-array.detector: node --test test/lessons-burndown.test.js --test-name-pattern "current package privacy roots stay private"

ship-add-all-sweeps-regenerated-files.mechanism: commands/worktree.js restoreRegeneratedAdapterChurn skips unstaged AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and GEMINI.md churn; test/worktree-ship-detached.test.js pins it.
